# E-Captcha Solver

> PyTorch CRNN-CTC OCR model that reads E-captcha text captchas (5 characters from the alphabet `abcdefghjkmnrstuvyz`) with about 95% accuracy. Inference runs in Python, over HTTP with FastAPI, or in Node.js through ONNX.

Install with `pip install -r requirements.txt`. The repository ships no trained weights: put a `ctc_model.pt` in the project root, or train one with `train_ctc.py`, before calling `CaptchaSolver("ctc_model.pt").solve("captcha.jpg")`, which returns `(text, confidence)`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/halitsever/e-captcha-solver/blob/main/Readme.md): model overview, install, CLI, Python, HTTP and Node usage, training
- [infer.py](https://github.com/halitsever/e-captcha-solver/blob/main/infer.py): `CaptchaSolver` Python API
- [model_ctc.py](https://github.com/halitsever/e-captcha-solver/blob/main/model_ctc.py): CRNN architecture, alphabet and preprocessing
- [server.py](https://github.com/halitsever/e-captcha-solver/blob/main/server.py): FastAPI `/solve` endpoint
- [node/solve.js](https://github.com/halitsever/e-captcha-solver/blob/main/node/solve.js): Node.js ONNX inference
- [train_ctc.py](https://github.com/halitsever/e-captcha-solver/blob/main/train_ctc.py): training script
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/halitsever/e-captcha-solver/blob/main/AGENTS.md): build, verify and gotchas for contributors

- [Source](https://github.com/halitsever/e-captcha-solver): repository
